scope: Recorded generation evidence and regression observations, not a language-quality score or product acceptance certificate.

policy.confirmedDefects: Retain explicit source/structure violations and reproducible counterexamples; editorial preference alone is insufficient.

editorialNotes.quote: 我會請他們把時間表寄給我們。
editorialNotes.note: The source envíen has morphology shared by ellos/ellas and formal plural ustedes; the subtitles do not establish the subordinate sender identity. 他們 selects a third party, whereas neutral 對方 would preserve the unresolved role. A third-party reading may still be natural generic translation. The new explanation calls the subject third-person plural, which by itself can describe the grammatical agreement used with ustedes and does not independently settle discourse person. This is the same editorial ambiguity kept pending in prompts-19, not a new definite error. An independent language editor should decide the acceptable translation scope.

editorialNotes.quote: 你打電話來的時候我正準備要走。
editorialNotes.note: Called is translated as a telephone call. That is a natural reading but the source also permits calling out; the medium is not explicitly established. This keeps the same nonblocking lexical ambiguity treatment as the preceding English controls.

editorialNotes.quote: 詢問滯留原由與請求稍候
editorialNotes.note: 滯留 can suggest being delayed or unable to leave more strongly than still here establishes. It can also be read broadly as remaining, so this is a precision warning rather than a definite event error. A neutral title such as 詢問停留原因 would better preserve the source scope.
